goal: 10-hour unattended implementation and verified progress report
notes: This file tracks scheduled automation iterations, not product completion. Increment sprint_run on each future scheduled run.
baseline: experimental browser-side statistical synthetic data preview with unit tests

iterations.changes: Reject incomplete source previews and likely numeric identifier columns in statistical demo; add regression tests.
Harden CSV/TSV parsing against malformed quotes, excess fields, empty headers and oversized schemas; neutralize spreadsheet formula cells on CSV export; add parser security regression tests.
Add deterministic per-column schema inference and complete-dataset drift checks with regression tests. Track missing-rate shifts, removed/added columns and type changes; reject sampled inputs.
Fix CSV formula neutralization and quoting, add spreadsheet-injection regressions, align schema-drift expectation for empty-column transition.
Guard synthetic evaluation against sampled or incomplete inputs, mismatched schemas, duplicate columns and inaccurate row counts; add regression tests.
Add complete ancestor/descendant dataset lineage traversal, missing-parent and cycle diagnostics, navigable history UI and regression tests.

Prevent deletion of ancestor datasets with derived children/grandchildren; fresh Firestore snapshot precheck and browser-local guard, with regression tests. Cloud guard is non-transactional and not a substitute for server-side enforcement.
Implement complete-dataset column quality report with missingness, distinct counts, inferred types, numeric bounds, duplicates and safety guards; add regression tests.
Wire full-file per-column quality analysis into dataset Quality tab, with explicit 2 MB and format guards; preserve white UI and display real metrics only after user-triggered complete-file parsing.
